title: Live Update 1.45.0
body:
# Live Update 1.45.0

Raiders,

Update 1.45.0 is now live, bringing several fixes, a new Raider Project, the launch of the fifth Expedition, the Hornet Hunter Set, and upcoming changes to Cred. Restart your game to receive the download.

This is the final Live Update before October 8, but development continues in the meantime, a smaller update is still scheduled to arrive before that date.

# **HIGHLIGHTS**

* Raider Project: Ascending the Mountain

* The Hornet Hunter Set

* Cred Expiration

* Expedition 5

* Community Rubber Ducks

# **Forging the Way North**

Investigations by Raiders have uncovered clues about mysterious phantom ARC signals that have caught Shani's attention. Unfortunately, these signals trace back to a location we cannot yet reach, the mountain range that sits beyond our Tube system's range. Word is that Apollo is developing an experimental solution and is calling on Raiders skilled with schematics who can operate discreetly.

# **Cred Expiration**

With Frozen Trail and an overhaul of Raider Decks approaching, we are making changes to the Cred currency. Cred will stay usable until October 8, so spend any remaining Cred before that date.

We are phasing out Cred as a currency in favor of a broader reward system that will debut alongside the Frozen Trail Update. Every reward currently available through Raider Decks will carry over into the new system. Any rewards you have already claimed before the update remain yours.

Any Cred left in your account will expire once the Frozen Trail update arrives, so make sure to use it with Shani or toward outstanding Raider Deck rewards beforehand.

# **Community Rubber Ducks**

The community-designed duckies you voted for have finally arrived in the game! Visit Bird City to display them proudly inside your Raider Den!

Congratulations again to the designers: gekko.rar, im_AshCheeks and nassguhl!

# **Content and Bug Fixes**

## ARC

* Snitch Scanners now spawn ARC in the same manner as regular Snitches, though the odds of stronger ARC appearing are lower.

## Audio

* Fixed a bug where holstering the Equalizer could trigger its firing sound effect.

* Fixed a bug where voice chat failed to function while Raider Voice was turned on.

## Customization

* The Boonie outfit becomes available starting September 15th.

## Gameplay

* Landing on a moving surface now causes you to follow that surface only once you've landed, rather than while airborne.

* Quick item cycling can now be rebound separately from the quick-use wheel, or turned off entirely, and both can share the same keybind. This change reduces accidental item swaps after closing the wheel.

* Fixed a bug that prevented pinging ARC Turbine mines.

* Reduced weapon sway on the Aphelion for steadier aiming.

* Beginning an Expedition no longer automatically resets your quests; you can now decide whether to reset them upon departure.

* Fixed a bug allowing the Matriarch's stomp attack to deal damage through tall cover or to players standing on top of the Matriarch.

## Stability

* Fixed a PS5 crash that could occur soon after a session began.

* Fixed a crash triggered by rapidly pressing certain keys during gameplay.

* Fixed situations where a squad could get stuck after a squadmate logged out and back in, which blocked the ready-up process and stopped matchmaking from starting.

## Performance

* Updated Unreal Engine from version 5.3 to 5.7.

## UI

* The loadout weight indicator now updates immediately when you drop part of a stack.

* Added small visual improvements to selected nodes within the Skill Tree.

* Fixed a bug causing some distance-based map markers to display incorrectly.

* The pickup prompt now displays "loadout full" when attempting to grab an item while your inventory has no space.

* Matchmaking error messages are now clearer, showing better explanations when you lose connection while queuing or when crossplay settings conflict, making it easier to identify why matchmaking failed.

# **KNOWN ISSUES**

* Some players were unable to start the second part of the Phantom Targets project. Compensation for this will be issued in a future update.

* Several stability fixes are aimed at reducing Xbox Series S crashes. Please report any crashes that persist so we can continue improving this.

* We are aware of crashes on PC linked to Windows Update KB5121003. A workaround has been shared elsewhere while a permanent fix is developed.

* Some players on Epic may experience sudden loss of keyboard input.

* While this is being investigated, we suggest turning off any active Overlay software. Alt-tabbing out of and back into the game may also help.

* The Rawhide headgear remains visible even when its toggle is set to off.

* The throw animation sometimes fails to play when detonating a Trigger 'Nade right after throwing it.

* The weapon swap animation can appear glitched if you swap weapons immediately after vaulting.

* Player animations may look broken if a search of the Baron Husk is interrupted.

* Shredders sometimes float up to the ceiling in certain rooms within the Hidden Bunker.

* Leapers are able to jump through the ARC Turbine.

* Shots fired while riding ARC may not always register properly.

* Some doors let the light from player flashlights pass through them instead of blocking it.

* Clipping issues have been identified with the Triumph, Reaver and Azimuth outfits.

See you Topside, //Ossen
